name: media
title: Media
description: One row per clip: PEP 0005 §3's clip (src, poster, t0, fps, duration, basis), plus the run, the camera and the kind.

fields.name: src
fields.description: the clip, relative to the data file

fields.name: poster
fields.description: its first frame as an image

fields.name: t0
fields.description: the clock's t at the clip's frame 0

fields.name: basis
fields.description: what made it: real-camera, sim-render, screen-capture or illustrative

fields.name: camera
fields.description: the camera, as samples' device names it

fields.name: kind
fields.description: rgb, depth (a colourised video) or band (one hyperspectral band)

fields.name: band_nm
fields.description: a band's centre wavelength, in nanometres (the one _nm that is not a torque)
